inputSchema.title: string — centered bold title at top
inputSchema.text: string — simple fallback when no sections
inputSchema.pages: Array<{ title?: string, text: string, fontSize?: number }> — legacy append-page mode

ChildNode.heading: number 1-6 — heading level (required for heading type)

inputSchema.title: string — title paragraph at top (centered, large)
inputSchema.margins: { top, right, bottom, left } in DXA units (default 720 each = 0.5in)

ChildNode.heading: number 1-6 — heading level (required for heading type)
ChildNode.rows: string[][] — for table (first row = bold+gray header)
ChildNode.headerRow: boolean (default true) — style first row as header

SheetDef.name: string — tab name (max 31 chars)
SheetDef.data: string[][] — rows of cells (first row = header if options.header not false)
SheetDef.colWidths: number[] — per-column widths in characters (auto-calculated if omitted)
SheetDef.formats: string[] — per-column number format strings e.g. ['', '$#,##0.00', '0%', 'YYYY-MM-DD']
SheetDef.options: { header?: boolean } — set header false to skip header styling

inputSchema.title: string — title slide text
inputSchema.subtitle: string or {text,color} — subtitle on title slide
inputSchema.background: string — hex fill color for title slide e.g. '#1E40AF'

SlideDef.title: string — slide heading
SlideDef.background: string — hex fill color for slide
SlideDef.color: string — default text color for slide
SlideDef.fontSize: number — override font size for this slide

inputSchema.html: string — HTML body content (or full SVG content, or raw text)
inputSchema.title: string — <title> tag content (for html/htm type)
inputSchema.css: string — optional inline CSS added in <style> block

generators.description: Generate ZIP archives with multiple files

inputSchema.files: Array<{ path: string, content: string, encoding?: 'utf8'|'base64' }>
